title: 12 White Castle Lawns, Athy, Co. Kildare, R14TR74
seoTitle: 12 White Castle Lawns, Athy, Co. Kildare, R14TR74
description:
Connaughton Auctioneers are delighted to present this superb four-bedroom detached bungalow to the market. Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac within the highly sought-after Whitecastle Lawns development, this beautifully modernised family home is presented in excellent turnkey condition and offers spacious, light-filled accommodation together with stunning landscaped gardens.
The welcoming entrance hall immediately impresses with its striking vaulted timber ceiling, creating a wonderful sense of space and character. The generous living room enjoys a beautiful bay window with a built-in window seat overlooking the front garden, while a solid fuel stove with an elegant white marble surround provides a warm and inviting focal point.
The spacious kitchen/dining room is fitted with an extensive range of modern units and quality integrated appliances, offering excellent storage and workspace. Patio doors open directly onto the rear garden, making this an ideal space for both everyday family living and entertaining. The existing chimney breast also provides the opportunity to install a solid fuel or wood-burning stove if desired. The dining area comfortably accommodates a large family dining table.
There are four generously proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious master bedroom with en suite shower room. The recently refurbished family bathroom features a contemporary bathroom suite together with an electric shower over the bath.
The property has been upgraded with a modern oil-fired central heating system incorporating digital heating controls. A solar panel mounted on the gable end has the potential to provide an energy-efficient supply of hot water, while high-quality uPVC double glazed windows and doors further enhance the home`s comfort and efficiency.
Externally, the gardens are a real feature of the property. The beautifully landscaped rear garden includes raised flower beds, two large paved patio areas, a decking area, a timber garden shed and two gated side entrances. To the front, a large lawn is complemented by extensive private parking suitable for several vehicles.
A substantial block-built detached garage together with an enclosed car port provides excellent storage, workshop space or further potential for a variety of uses.
